-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [Perfil] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Perfil_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @PerfilFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Perfil_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @PerfilFilter (Perfil_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Perfil].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Perfil]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Perfil].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @PerfilFilter (Perfil_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Perfil].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Perfil]
		WHERE
			 [Perfil].[Activo] = 1

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Perfil].[Id],
		[Perfil].[Nombre],
		[Perfil].[Descripcion],
		[Perfil].[Activo],
		[Perfil].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[Perfil].[DesactivadoPor],
		[Perfil].[FechaCreacion],
		[Perfil].[CreadoPor],
		[Perfil].[FechaModificacion],
		[Perfil].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @PerfilFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Perfil] 
			ON [Perfil].[Id] = filter.[Perfil_Id] 
			


END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_Perfil_Index]
Name: rpt_Perfil_Index
